turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty, the situation you describe is indeed delicate. I trust Mr. Holmes will provide the guidance you seek.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have come to you because I believe in your discretion and expertise, Mr. Holmes. The matter concerns my former fiancée, Irene Adler, and a compromising photograph.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. Let us proceed to the facts. You wish to retrieve the photograph in question without alarming the lady.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes, your insight is precisely what I require. I cannot risk my reputation or the stability of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Certainly, Your Majesty. Mr. Holmes will approach the matter with the utmost delicacy and respect for your position.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am in your capable hands, Mr. Holmes. The photograph in question must be retrieved, but I cannot overstate the delicacy of this mission. My kingdom's peace hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Of course, Your Majesty. Mr. Holmes and I will ensure that your request is handled with the utmost confidentiality and care.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I will need to know every detail of your encounter with the lady in question, from the beginning. There can be no secrets between us if we are to succeed.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I understand, Mr. Holmes. I shall recount everything from the start, though I fear the truth may be both shocking and embarrassing.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Proceed, Your Majesty. The sooner you begin, the sooner we may uncover a solution to your dilemma.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall tell you everything, but I must emphasize the utmost secrecy. My reputation and the stability of my realm are at stake.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I can assure you, Your Majesty, that Mr. Holmes and I hold the highest regard for discretion. We are here to assist you and will do everything in our power to maintain your confidentiality.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us proceed then, Your Majesty. Begin with the circumstances surrounding your encounter with the lady.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. The lady in question is none other than my former fiancée, the Honourable Helen Stoner. The matter at hand is of a deeply personal nature, and it involves a piece of correspondence that has come to threaten my position and my peace of mind.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I understand the gravity of your situation, Your Majesty. Please, continue with the details of this correspondence and how it has come to pose a threat.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The letter in question is a recent missive from Helen, threatening to expose a scandalous secret from our past. It could ruin me politically and cause a diplomatic crisis. I implore you, Mr. Holmes, to find this letter and ensure it does not fall into the wrong hands.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I will need a copy of the letter in question and any other relevant documents or artifacts from your encounter with Miss Stoner. Additionally, I require a full account of your interactions with her since your engagement was dissolved.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. I will provide you with everything you need. I have already instructed my secretary to send the letter and other pertinent documents to you at your residence. Please, proceed with caution and discretion.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. Dr. Watson and I will begin our investigation immediately and will keep you informed of our progress. Discretion is indeed of the utmost importance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I trust in your wisdom and skill, Mr. Holmes. Should there be any development that requires my immediate attention, please do not hesitate to contact me. Until then, I must return to my duties, concealing my involvement as I am sure you understand.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
